title: Connecting with Your Values as an Aspiring Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能获得收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”计划现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年参加了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的心路历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，不收取额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森礼品以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth, and I'm a psychological well-being practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫贝丝，是一名来自纽卡斯尔的心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我只是想对《临床心理学家合集》一书的撰稿人们表示最诚挚的谢意。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢阅读这本书，也很高兴能深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前所拥有的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 看到申请中潜在的障碍以及我如何尝试克服这些障碍，这也非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the Clinical Psychology Doctorate,
sentences.zh: 我曾一度开始怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否有资格申请临床心理学博士学位，

sentences.en: but this has really given me the confidence boost that I needed to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但这确实给了我试一试所需的信心。

sentences.en: So, the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的非常非常感谢。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这本书成为你的指路明灯吧。

sentences.en: The Aspire with Dr. Mary Andrew.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·安德鲁博士的《逐梦心理学家》。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《逐梦心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: If you are watching on YouTube, you will have noticed that I am actually talking to camera.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，你就会发现我其实是在对着镜头说话。

sentences.en: This is just a little of me, but I'm also on camera today.
sentences.zh: 这只是我的一小部分，但今天我也出镜了。

sentences.en: So, if you're not listening on YouTube, you could come along and see me talk through what we're going to be talking to you about today, but there is no pressure.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你不是在YouTube上收听，你可以过来看看我讲述我们要讨论的内容，不过这全凭自愿，没有压力。

sentences.en: So, if you are in the UK at the moment, you will have noticed there's lots of stuff in the media still about grief and, you know, people talking about a grief hangover.
sentences.zh: 如果你目前在英国，你就会发现媒体上仍然有很多关于悲伤的内容，你知道的，人们在讨论悲伤带来的宿醉感。

sentences.en: And that's something that people have been telling me about kind of personally and professionally, you know,
sentences.zh: 这是人们在个人和职业层面向我倾诉的事情，你知道的，

sentences.en: the effect of the media and the kind of more dour presentation and the songs and the music and the kind of reflective things that we've been subjected to really as part of living in the UK.
sentences.zh: 媒体的影响、那种更显沉闷的呈现方式、歌曲、音乐，以及我们生活在英国这一现实所带来的那种反思性的东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, that can feel tricky because what we know is that it doesn't always feel safe to be sad.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这可能会让人感到棘手，因为我们知道，感到难过并不总是安全的。

sentences.en: But for me, you know, I very much try to live by my values and my values as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但对我而言，你知道，我非常努力地按照自己的价值观生活，作为一名心理学家的价值观。

sentences.en: And I think that, you know, being able to tap into all of our range of emotions, including sadness, which is key, is very important to me, both personally and professionally.
sentences.zh: 我认为，能够调动我们所有的情绪，包括至关重要的悲伤，对我来说无论在个人还是职业上都非常重要。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I'm always intrigued to know what your values are.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我一直很好奇你的价值观是什么。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to be doing a values exercise for me, based on me, using some acceptance and commitment therapy values cards.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将使用一些接纳承诺疗法的价值观卡片，围绕我自己做一个价值观练习。

sentences.en: So, why don't you, you know, see how you get on with this exercise?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么不（你知道的）看看你对这个练习感觉如何呢？

sentences.en: In fact, if you'd like to come on and do an aspiring psychologist set of values episode, let me know and I'll have you on as a gueSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你想上节目做一期“逐梦心理学家”价值观主题的节目，请告诉我，我会邀请你作为嘉宾。

sentences.en: Let me know if you'd be up for that.
sentences.zh: 如果你有兴趣，请告诉我。

sentences.en: So, what we're going to do is we're firstly going to pick the goal I want to work on and then I'm going to identify my core values out of a big set of values.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们要做的首先是挑选我要致力实现的目标，然后从一大堆价值观中找出我的核心价值观。

sentences.en: So, let's get on with that.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们就开始吧。

sentences.en: So, picking from the life domains, can I show you that so that you can see it on camera?
sentences.zh: 那么，从生活领域中挑选，我能把它展示出来以便你在镜头前看到它吗？

sentences.en: We've got family, parenting, intimate partner, friends and social life, work and career, health, education and learning, environment, community, spirituality,
sentences.zh: 我们有家庭、育儿、亲密伴侣、朋友与社交生活、工作与事业、健康、教育与学习、环境、社区、灵性，

sentences.en: personal growth and leisure.
sentences.zh: 个人成长与休闲。

sentences.en: And I am going to, because we're talking about psychology, I'm going to talk about work and career in this.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在谈论心理学，我将谈论其中的工作和事业。

sentences.en: So, there's a massive, massive stack of values to work through.
sentences.zh: 这里有一大堆、一大堆需要筛选的价值观。

sentences.en: And what I've done is I've picked a section of them, a selection of them, and I've whittled down the ones that are most important to me.
sentences.zh: 我所做的是挑选了其中的一部分，精选出对我最重要的那些。

sentences.en: So, in no particular order, we have cooperation.
sentences.zh: 所以，排名不分先后，我们有合作。

sentences.en: So, to be cooperative and collaborative with others.
sentences.zh: 也就是与他人合作和协作。

sentences.en: We have contribution.
sentences.zh: 我们有奉献。

sentences.en: To contribute, give, help, assist, share or be generous.
sentences.zh: 去奉献、给予、帮助、协助、分享或慷慨大方。

sentences.en: Creativity.
sentences.zh: 创造力。

sentences.en: To be creative or innovative at work or at play.
sentences.zh: 在工作或娱乐中具有创造力或创新精神。

sentences.en: We have truSt.
sentences.zh: 我们有信任。

sentences.en: To be trustworthy, loyal, faithful, sincere and reliable and or be trusting of others.
sentences.zh: 要值得信赖、忠诚、忠实、真诚、可靠，并且/或者信任他人。

sentences.en: We have friendliness.
sentences.zh: 我们有友善。

sentences.en: To be warm, friendly, open, accepting, agreeable and helpful towards others.
sentences.zh: 对他人热情、友好、开放、包容、随和且乐于助人。

sentences.en: We have industry.
sentences.zh: 我们有勤奋。

sentences.en: To be industrious, hardworking, committed, proactive or dedicated.
sentences.zh: 勤劳、努力、投入、积极主动或专心致志。

sentences.en: We have honesty.
sentences.zh: 我们有诚实。

sentences.en: To be honest, truthful and sincere with myself and others.
sentences.zh: 对自己和他人诚实、不说谎且真诚。

sentences.en: Safety.
sentences.zh: 安全。

sentences.en: To secure, protect or ensure my own safety or that of others.
sentences.zh: 确保、保护或保障我自身或他人的安全。

sentences.en: Compassion.
sentences.zh: 同情心。

sentences.en: To act kindly towards myself and or others when in pain.
sentences.zh: 在痛苦时对自己和/或他人表现出善意。

sentences.en: Courage.
sentences.zh: 勇气。

sentences.en: To be courageous or brave.
sentences.zh: 表现出勇气或勇敢。

sentences.en: To persist in the face of fear, uncertainty and threatening circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在面对恐惧、不确定性和威胁时坚持不懈。

sentences.en: Connection.
sentences.zh: 专注/连接。

sentences.en: To engage fully in whatever I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 全身心投入我正在做的任何事情中。

sentences.en: To give the activity or the person I'm with my full attention.
sentences.zh: 把我全部的注意力投入到活动或我陪伴的人身上。

sentences.en: And last but not least, curiosity.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，好奇心。

sentences.en: To be curious, open-minded and interested.
sentences.zh: 保持好奇、开放的心态和兴趣。

sentences.en: Eager to explore, discover and learn.
sentences.zh: 渴望探索、发现和学习。

sentences.en: And out of those, I picked some top ones.
sentences.zh: 在这些之中，我挑选了一些最重要的。

sentences.en: So I whittled it down to curiosity, connection, courage, compassion and friendliness.
sentences.zh: 我把范围缩小到了好奇心、专注、勇气、同情心和友善。

sentences.en: But that is too many.
sentences.zh: 但这有点太多了。

sentences.en: So, oh, and truSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，还有信任。

sentences.en: That's too many.
sentences.zh: 这实在太多了。

sentences.en: So, um, I'm going to go for compassion, connection.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我打算选择同情心、专注。

sentences.en: I'm going to go for four.
sentences.zh: 我打算选四个。

sentences.en: Technically, we're only supposed to have three.
sentences.zh: 严格来说，我们应该只选三个。

sentences.en: Curiosity and courage.
sentences.zh: 好奇心和勇气。

sentences.en: And the rest of them, I'm going to say, thank you.
sentences.zh: 至于剩下的，我想说，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: You're very important to me.
sentences.zh: 你们对我很重要。

sentences.en: But my core values as a professional are those of curiosity, courage, connection and compassion.
sentences.zh: 但我作为专业人士的核心价值观是好奇心、勇气、专注和同情心。

sentences.en: Now, already I'm thinking, oh, no, I'm missing.
sentences.zh: 现在，我已经在想，哦，不，我漏掉了什么。

sentences.en: I miss those other bits.
sentences.zh: 我漏掉了其他那些部分。

sentences.en: But I think these are, you know, my core values, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这些是（你知道的）我的核心价值观，我这么认为。

sentences.en: Okay, so the next part of this activity is living your values.
sentences.zh: 好的，这个活动的下一部分是践行你的价值观。

sentences.en: So when I'm living by these values of compassion, connection, courage and curiosity, how do I treat myself?
sentences.zh: 所以，当我践行同情心、专注、勇气和好奇心这些价值观时，我如何对待自己？

sentences.en: How do I treat others?
sentences.zh: 我如何对待他人？

sentences.en: How do I treat my body?
sentences.zh: 我如何对待自己的身体？

sentences.en: How do I treat my work and education?
sentences.zh: 我如何对待我的工作和教育？

sentences.en: How do I treat my interests or hobbies?
sentences.zh: 我如何对待我的兴趣或爱好？

sentences.en: And how do I treat the world around me?
sentences.zh: 我如何对待我周围的世界？

sentences.en: Okay, so when I treat myself, I very much practice being compassionate these days.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当我对待自己时，这些天我非常注重练习同情自己。

sentences.en: And that was something that I didn't really have along my journey to being an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在我成为一名逐梦心理学家的旅程中，我并没有真正具备这一点。

sentences.en: And so very much in the upcoming aspiring psychologist book, I encourage you and the other people within that book encourage you to be self-compassionate.
sentences.zh: 因此，在即将出版的《逐梦心理学家》一书中，我鼓励你，书中其他人也鼓励你要对自己充满同情。

sentences.en: And I think that is absolutely key.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是关键。

sentences.en: And we have a foreword by Dr. Chris Irons in the book as well, who is, you know, one of the very leading voices in self-compassion and compassion-focused therapy right now.
sentences.zh: 书里还有克里斯·艾恩斯博士写的序言，你知道的，他目前是自我同情和聚焦同情疗法领域最主要的权威声音之一。

sentences.en: So it's a real privilege to have him in the book.
sentences.zh: 所以能邀请他为本书作序是一种真正的荣幸。

sentences.en: I'm very grateful for him saying yes.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激他答应了。

sentences.en: And I guess that's one of my values as well is courage.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是我的价值观之一，那就是勇气。

sentences.en: You know, I asked him if he would do it and he said yes, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我邀请他来写序，他答应了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I guess I have similar courage with my clients.
sentences.zh: 我想我对我的客户也有类似的勇气。

sentences.en: So I have the courage to have difficult conversations.
sentences.zh: 我有勇气进行艰难的对话。

sentences.en: I have the curiosity to explore that in a way that doesn't feel intrusive, you know, a way that still feels respectful.
sentences.zh: 我有好奇心去探索这一点，以一种不会让人觉得唐突的方式，你知道的，一种仍然让人感到尊重的方式。

sentences.en: So we have that connection, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拥有那种联系，你知道的。

sentences.en: I have this almost palpable, visceral sense of connection with my clients and with people I work with.
sentences.zh: 我对我的客户和与我共事的人有一种几乎触手可及的、发自内心的连接感。

sentences.en: And that's really, really important to me.
sentences.zh: 这真的、真的很重要对我来说。

sentences.en: So I treat others with compassion.
sentences.zh: 所以我用同情心对待他人。

sentences.en: I demonstrate my courage to myself and to them.
sentences.zh: 我向自己和他们展现我的勇气。

sentences.en: And I'm curious about myself as well.
sentences.zh: 我也对自己的内心充满好奇。

sentences.en: I'm quite reflective generally.
sentences.zh: 我通常很有反思精神。

sentences.en: So I speak to you today whilst I've been to a funeral.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我是在参加完一场葬礼后跟你说话的。

sentences.en: Part of the grief continues.
sentences.zh: 悲伤的一部分仍在继续。

sentences.en: I'm hoping that's going to be it for us for now, for the next foreseeable.
sentences.zh: 我希望在可预见的未来，这对我们来说就到此为止了。

sentences.en: But, you know, I'm always curious about that.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我对此一直很好奇。

sentences.en: I'm curious to hear about others' lives and to learn about other people.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇去了解别人的生活并了解其他人。

sentences.en: I was just doing a live just before I started this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 就在我开始录制这个播客之前，我刚刚做了一场直播。

sentences.en: And I saw that my postman was back after a very long period of what I was assuming was sickness absence.
sentences.zh: 我看到我的邮递员在经历了很长一段时间（我猜是病假）之后又回来上班了。

sentences.en: But I actually went and stopped.
sentences.zh: 但我实际上走过去停了下来。

sentences.en: Well, he rang the doorbell and my husband was out.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他按了门铃，我丈夫不在家。

sentences.en: But I went to go and answer the door and I stopped the live and then came back to it.
sentences.zh: 但我去开门了，我停下了直播，然后又回到了直播中。

sentences.en: I was curious about him because I have a connection with him and I felt compassionate to him.
sentences.zh: 我对他的近况很好奇，因为我和他有一种连接，而且我对他也感到同情。

sentences.en: And I'm, you know, courageous as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我也很勇敢。

sentences.en: So I was like, oh, you know, how are you?
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就想，哦，你知道，你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Have you been?
sentences.zh: 你过得好吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, he tells me a story and I ended up singing him the song that my children had made up about him, about where he might be.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，他给我讲了一个故事，我最后甚至给他唱了我孩子们编的关于他的歌，关于他可能去过哪里。

sentences.en: It was basically his name, which I won't tell you because it's not appropriate for me to do that, you know,
sentences.zh: 基本上是他的名字，我不会告诉你，因为我这样做不合适，你知道的，

sentences.en: and ends in all the verses of different country names, where he might be.
sentences.zh: 歌词的结尾是各种国家名字的不同诗句，猜测他可能去了哪里。

sentences.en: They're trying to make sense of where the postman had gone.
sentences.zh: 他们试图弄明白邮递员去哪儿了。

sentences.en: And he very much enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 他非常喜欢这个。

sentences.en: And he said he was going to try and add a few more verses before he next saw me of other countries that he could have been in but wasn't.
sentences.zh: 他说，在他下次见到我之前，他要试着再添几句歌词，写写他可能去过但实际上没去过的其他国家。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I just try to be curious with everybody, really.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我真的只是努力对每个人都保持好奇心。

sentences.en: And I'm curious at work, treating my interests or hobbies.
sentences.zh: 我在工作中充满好奇心，在对待我的兴趣或爱好时也是如此。

sentences.en: I don't feel like I've got many at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我目前没有什么爱好。

sentences.en: It's mainly writing books and that's kind of taking a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 主要是写书，这占用了我大量的时间。

sentences.en: But I'm going to the theatre tomorrow and I'm also going the next week, which is entirely accidental scheduling.
sentences.zh: 但我明天要去看戏剧，下周还要去看，这完全是偶然的日程安排。

sentences.en: And, you know, I guess, am I going to be curious about that?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我想，我对这事会感到好奇吗？

sentences.en: I'm kind of curious because I'm going to be seeing something that I don't really remember wanting to see.
sentences.zh: 我有点好奇，因为我要去看一部我其实记不清自己想看的剧。

sentences.en: And yet, apparently, I did agree to go and see it.
sentences.zh: 然而，显然我确实同意去看它。

sentences.en: And that's Mamma Mia.
sentences.zh: 那是《妈妈咪呀》。

sentences.en: I'm not hugely looking forward to it.
sentences.zh: 我其实不是很期待。

sentences.en: It's also my wedding anniversary that it's on.
sentences.zh: 演出那天正好是我的结婚纪念日。

sentences.en: And so I didn't even know I was, I didn't remember where I was going because I would have thought originally I said no to going out on my wedding anniversary day.
sentences.zh: 所以甚至都不知道我要去哪，因为原本我想象中自己会拒绝在结婚纪念日那天出门。

sentences.en: So I'm curious about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此感到好奇。

sentences.en: How's that going to be?
sentences.zh: 那会是怎样的体验呢？

sentences.en: I think sometimes, as my sister-in-law just said to me, if you've got low expectations, then you're easily pleased.
sentences.zh: 我想有时候，正如我嫂子刚才对我说的那样，如果你把期望值放低，那么你就会很容易满足。

sentences.en: And I think that's going to be the case for this for this this musical I'm going to.
sentences.zh: 我想我去看这部音乐剧时也会是这样。

sentences.en: So that's living by my values.
sentences.zh: 这就是践行我的价值观。

sentences.en: So how would I set goals in the next 24 hours, in the next week, in the next two weeks, month, year and decade?
sentences.zh: 那么，我该如何在接下来的24小时、接下来的一个星期、两周、一个月、一年和十年里设定目标呢？

sentences.en: Decade's a big one, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 十年是个很大的跨度，对吧？

sentences.en: So I would want to continue to be connected with others.
sentences.zh: 所以我会希望继续与他人保持联系。

sentences.en: So even though I do lots of passive stuff,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管我做了很多被动的事情，

sentences.en: I will always do one-to-one client work because it's really important to me to have that sense of connection and to be able to help demonstrate my skills in compassion,
sentences.zh: 我始终会做一对一的客户工作，因为对我来说，拥有那种连接感，并能够展现我的同理心、

sentences.en: curiosity and courage.
sentences.zh: 好奇心和勇气，真的很重要。

sentences.en: So in the next decade, I would hope to still be seeing clients and in holding on to those values that will very much keep keep me grounded and keep me focused.
sentences.zh: 所以在接下来的十年里，我希望能继续接待客户，并坚守那些能让我脚踏实地、专注前行的价值观。

sentences.en: And I really liked that when I was working in the NHS,
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢以前在英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）工作时，

sentences.en: some of the people in more senior management had still kept a very small caseload because I guess that sense of connection and sense of doing something in industry was really important to them to be doing their core profession.
sentences.zh: 一些高层管理人员仍然保留着非常少量的个案工作，因为我想这种连接感以及在行业中做点实事的感觉，对他们从事核心专业工作非常重要。

sentences.en: And I absolutely think that I would have been the same as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我绝对相信，如果是我，我也会是一样的。

sentences.en: So I probably would have been, if I progressed and progressed, I'd have been the chief exec that still had, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我不断晋升、不断晋升，我大概会成为那种仍然拥有，你知道的，

sentences.en: a clinic and saw three clients a week because it was really important to me to do that.
sentences.zh: 一个诊所并且每周看诊三个客户的首席执行官，因为这对我来说真的很重要。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think I'm very much, I've got an idea of where my work is going.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我觉得我非常清楚我的工作方向。

sentences.en: Perhaps we'd like to do some more training in compassion focused therapy and to continue with my supervisory relationships as well for connection and curiosity.
sentences.zh: 也许我们想在同理心焦点疗法（CFT）方面接受更多培训，并继续我的督导关系，以获得连接感和好奇心。

sentences.en: So I'm going to whip through these because we haven't got a super amount of time.
sentences.zh: 所以我要快速讲完这些，因为我们的时间不是很多。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to do action planning, which is where we look at the actions we take to achieve the goals.
sentences.zh: 因此我不会讲行动规划，也就是我们研究为实现目标而采取的行动。

sentences.en: We're going to look at encouraging values and we're going to look at that after this short break, which I hope you enjoy.
sentences.zh: 我们要探讨的是如何践行价值观，我们将在稍后这段希望大家会喜欢的短暂休息之后再讨论。

sentences.en: Enjoy the jingle, won't you?
sentences.zh: 喜欢这段音乐插曲吧？

sentences.en: Clinical Psychologist Collective book is the book to read for aspiring psychologists.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家集锦》这本书是立志成为心理学家的必读之书。

sentences.en: Like most aspiring psychologists, I've read all the books about becoming a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 就像大多数有志成为心理学家的人一样，我已经读过所有关于如何成为临床心理学家的书。

sentences.en: While other books break down the entry criteria and speak of the course competitiveness,
sentences.zh: 虽然其他书会剖析准入门槛并谈论课程的竞争激烈程度，

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective reveals the varied journeys and individual differences of those who've gotten onto and completed training.
sentences.zh: 但《临床心理学家集锦》揭示了那些成功进入并完成培训的人们丰富多样的心路历程和个体差异。

sentences.en: It inspired me to embrace my own journey and make the most of my experiences and identity.
sentences.zh: 它启发我拥抱自己的旅程，并充分利用我的经历和身份。

sentences.en: If you read one book about becoming a clinical psychologist, this is it.
sentences.zh: 如果你只读一本关于如何成为临床心理学家的书，那就是这本。

sentences.en: If you buy someone who aspires to be a clinical psychologist a book, this is it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想送给立志成为临床心理学家的人一本书，那就是这本。

sentences.en: This book will help the profession blossom into a more diverse group of mental health practitioners who use their backgrounds to enhance their ability to support those we serve.
sentences.zh: 这本书将帮助这个行业发展成为一个更加多元化的心理健康从业者群体，他们利用自身的背景来增强自己支持服务对象的能力。

sentences.en: To you, let's think some more about my personal values as a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 接下来，让我们多思考一下我作为一名合格临床心理学家的个人价值观。

sentences.en: And this might well be a really useful exercise that you could do.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是一个对你非常有用的小练习。

sentences.en: And like I said in the first half, if you might be interested in coming on as a guest on the podcast to explore your values as an aspiring psychologist,
sentences.zh: 就像我在前半部分所说的，如果你有兴趣作为嘉宾来到播客节目中，探讨你作为一名立志成为心理学家的人的价值观，

sentences.en: then do let me know and let's see what we can sort out.
sentences.zh: 那么一定要让我知道，看看我们能如何安排。

sentences.en: So if you didn't catch the first half, my values I've identified are compassion, connection, courage and curiosity.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你没有听前半部分，我确定的价值观是同理心、连接感、勇气和好奇心。

sentences.en: So those are the ones that I have picked out from a large selection of values.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是我从大量的价值观中挑选出来的。

sentences.en: So how will I encourage those values?
sentences.zh: 那么我将如何践行这些价值观呢？

sentences.en: And who else would I like to encourage these values in?
sentences.zh: 我又希望在谁身上践行这些价值观呢？

sentences.en: Well, I'd very much like to encourage the values of compassion and courage and curiosity within my children.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我非常希望在我的孩子身上培养同理心、勇气和好奇心这些价值观。

sentences.en: I think that's really important.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很重要。

sentences.en: You know, I blubbed a river full of tears when I went to my eldest child's first merit assembly, which I think was in reception year.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我大孩子去参加他的第一次荣誉表彰大会时，我哭得稀里哗啦，那好像是在学前班一年级。

sentences.en: So he would have been four and he was given his merit.
sentences.zh: 所以他当时应该四岁，他被授予了荣誉奖。

sentences.en: And within the merit award, they mentioned his kindness, you know, a number of times.
sentences.zh: 在荣誉奖的颁奖词中，他们好几次提到了他的善良，你知道的。

sentences.en: And then teachers came up to me afterwards to tell me what a kind little boy he was and how thoughtful he was to his peers in the class and to the staff as well.
sentences.zh: 后来老师们走到我面前，告诉我他是一个多么善良的小男孩，他对班上的同伴以及对教职员工都多么体贴。

sentences.en: And, you know, that just really moved me, actually.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这真的让我很感动。

sentences.en: You know, it's really, really wonderful.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这真的是太棒了。

sentences.en: I really, really think that kindness is the most wonderful thing.
sentences.zh: 我真的真的认为善良是最美妙的事情。

sentences.en: But kindness isn't the same as letting people walk all over you.
sentences.zh: 但善良并不等于任人践踏。

sentences.en: You know, it isn't.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，确实如此。

sentences.en: It's just that you know how nice it is to be connected with other people.
sentences.zh: 这只是因为你懂得与他人建立连接是多么美好的一件事。

sentences.en: And we can show people kindness without being a doormat.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在不当受气包的情况下向人们表现出善良。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And he's certainly nobody's doormat now that he's nine, but he's still, you know, very much reported as being a really nice member of the class that gets along with people and is,
sentences.zh: 而且他现在九岁了，当然绝对不是任何人的受气包，但据反映，他依然是一个非常讨人喜欢的班级成员，能与人和睦相处，而且，

sentences.en: you know, a pleasure to teach.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，教起来让人很开心。

sentences.en: Let's see what they say about his little brother.
sentences.zh: 来看看他们对他的小弟弟是怎么说的。

sentences.en: He's a little bit more of a handful.
sentences.zh: 他稍微更让人头疼一点。

sentences.en: But how can I model these values?
sentences.zh: 但我该如何为这些价值观树立榜样呢？

sentences.en: Well, it's really tricky, actually, as a mummy, you know, sometimes I try always to be compassionate, but I'm not always super patient, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，说实话这真的很棘手，作为一个妈妈，你知道的，有时我尽量做到充满同理心，但我并不总是那么有耐心，你知道的，

sentences.en: and maybe that's something for me to reflect upon.
sentences.zh: 也许这也是我需要反思的地方。

sentences.en: You know, how can I increase my patience to my pre-grief levels?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我该如何将我的耐心恢复到经历丧亲之痛前的水平呢？

sentences.en: So, before 2017, I feel like I was more easygoing.
sentences.zh: 所以，在2017年之前，我觉得自己更容易随遇而安。

sentences.en: I had more patience generally, but also the children are older now and are less compliant.
sentences.zh: 我通常有更多的耐心，但现在孩子们也长大了，没那么听话了。

sentences.en: You know, when I ask my eldest to go and brush his teeth now, I get one sec,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我叫大儿子去刷牙时，我得到的回答是“等一下”，

sentences.en: one sec, and then I prompt again a couple of minutes later because we're trying to hustle out the door.
sentences.zh: “等一下”，然后几分钟后我再次催促，因为我们正赶着出门。

sentences.en: And I still get one sec, and it's like, mummy can ask you kind of calmly and quite nicely, about three times.
sentences.zh: 我得到的还是“等一下”，这就好像，妈妈可以心平气和、态度很好地要求你大约三次。

sentences.en: But after that, I'm not going to be quite so calm, you know, so I absolutely used to be really into gentle parenting.
sentences.zh: 但在那之后，我就没办法那么平静了，你知道的，所以我以前绝对非常热衷于温和育儿。

sentences.en: But I just found it wasn't really, I still would, I guess, get on board with the philosophies of gentle parenting.
sentences.zh: 但我发现它其实并不太……我想我仍然会赞同温和育儿的理念。

sentences.en: But it's all very, I found it very easy when I just had one child, and it got trickier when I had two children.
sentences.zh: 但这全都很……我发现只有一个孩子时非常容易，而有了两个孩子后就变得更棘手了。

sentences.en: And as they both start to grow and want different things, I just found it a bit trickier.
sentences.zh: 随着他们俩都开始长大并想要不同的东西，我发现这变得更加棘手了。

sentences.en: So, on a great day, I'd still say I'm a gentle parent.
sentences.zh: 所以，在状态极佳的一天里，我仍然会说我是一个温和的父母。

sentences.en: I would tend to hope to say that I was compassionate and connected most of the time.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于希望自己大部分时间都是富有同理心且善于沟通的。

sentences.en: But when my youngest is trying to climb me whilst I'm trying to make breakfast, literally he climbs me like I'm like a tree and he's a monkey.
sentences.zh: 但当我的小儿子试图在我做早餐时爬到我身上时，字面意思，他像爬树我像猴子一样爬我。

sentences.en: Shins up me in all sorts, you know, cute to begin with.
sentences.zh: 顺着我的小腿往上爬各种姿势，你知道的，一开始挺可爱的。

sentences.en: But when you're trying to butter toast and stuff, it's a bit annoying, you know.
sentences.zh: 但当你试图给吐司抹黄油之类的东西时，这就有点烦人了，你知道的。

sentences.en: Get down, you know, we'll do this later.
sentences.zh: 下来，你知道的，我们待会儿再玩这个。

sentences.en: It's nice that you want to climb me.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你想爬我身上。

sentences.en: It's nice that you love me.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你爱我。

sentences.en: He's trying to climb up to kiss me as well.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还想爬上来亲吻我。

sentences.en: He's very cute, very cute.
sentences.zh: 他非常可爱，非常可爱。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I think I would like to think that I don't want the children to think I'm not connected to them or not compassionate towards them because I've got other things to do.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我想我希望孩子们不要认为我没有与他们建立连接，或者对他们缺乏同理心，只因为我还有别的事要做。

sentences.en: And I'm not as patient as I used to be.
sentences.zh: 而且我也没有以前那么有耐心了。

sentences.en: And I think maybe curiosity is something I could do with.
sentences.zh: 我想也许好奇心是我可以运用的一些东西。

sentences.en: A bit more for the kids, you know, so they often all the time tell me things that I don't know about Roblox or about football.
sentences.zh: 对孩子们多一点好奇，你知道的，所以他们经常一直告诉我一些我不知道的关于《Roblox》或足球的事情。

sentences.en: And it's not my specialist subject.
sentences.zh: 这不是我的专业领域。

sentences.en: It's not something I'm super, super interested in.
sentences.zh: 这不是我超级超级感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: But that's certainly something I perhaps now have identified my values will try to gently increase, you know, try to broaden that dialogue a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 但这绝对是我现在确定了自己的价值观后，会尝试温和地增加的事情，你知道的，试着稍微拓宽一下那种对话。

sentences.en: How can I initiate or teach or instruct these values?
sentences.zh: 我该如何发起、教授或传授这些价值观呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think I do that really well in my one to one work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我在一对一的工作中做得非常好。

sentences.en: Absolutely modeling that compassion and the connection and exploring the fact that it's safe, you know, to try courageous things in our sessions that you may not have done before.
sentences.zh: 绝对是在为同理心和连接感树立榜样，并探讨这样一件事：在我们的咨询中尝试那些你以前可能没做过的勇敢尝试是安全的，你知道的。

sentences.en: And to be curious and see whether we can take that outside of the therapeutic space to try that.
sentences.zh: 并且保持好奇心，看看我们是否能将这一点带到治疗空间之外去尝试。

sentences.en: And I absolutely encourage these values in you as aspiring psychologists as well.
sentences.zh: 我也绝对鼓励你们这些立志成为心理学家的人培养这些价值观。

sentences.en: And that's absolutely the case within the aspiring psychologist membership and the clinical psychologist collective and the aspiring psychologist collective,
sentences.zh: 对于立志成为心理学家会员俱乐部、《临床心理学家集锦》以及即将推出的“立志成为心理学家集锦”来说绝对也是如此，

sentences.en: which is coming out very soon, you'll be pleased to know, we should be on track for the 3rd of October.
sentences.zh: 你们会高兴地得知，它很快就要推出了，我们应该会在10月3日按计划发布。

sentences.en: So, yeah, exciting times.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，激动人心的时刻。

sentences.en: There is much to do still.
sentences.zh: 还有很多事情要做。

sentences.en: Lots of editing to be done.
sentences.zh: 有大量的编辑工作要完成。

sentences.en: But hopefully by the time you are listening to this podcast episode, the majority of it will be finished.
sentences.zh: 但希望当你听到这期播客节目时，大部分工作已经完成了。

sentences.en: So, yes, I may be laying flat in a dark room exhausted.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我可能会筋疲力尽地平躺在一个黑房间里。

sentences.en: But even then, I am being courageous in putting this book out there, being curious what you guys will think to it, connected because this is stuff you want, you know,
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，我在把这本书推向世界时依然表现得很勇敢，对你们会怎么看待它感到好奇，并与你们保持连接，因为这是你们想要的东西，你知道的，

sentences.en: stuff that you're interested in.
sentences.zh: 是你感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: You've told me, you know, this is something you want to read.
sentences.zh: 你告诉过我，你知道的，这是你想读的东西。

sentences.en: So, I'm listening to my audience and I'm being compassionate because it's absolutely very tricky to be the provider of mental health services in a mental health emergency,
sentences.zh: 所以，我在倾听受众的声音，我也在展现同理心，因为在心理健康紧急状况下作为心理健康服务的提供者绝对是非常棘手的，

sentences.en: which it feels like we're currently in in the UK as a result of many factors, but including the pandemic and the effects of that.
sentences.zh: 由于诸多因素，包括大流行及其影响，我们目前似乎正处于这种状况中。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I try to make sure that I am initiating and teaching those well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我努力确保自己能够很好地发起和传授这些价值观。

sentences.en: How can I create situations or environments or relationships where these values thrive?
sentences.zh: 我该如何创造能让这些价值观蓬勃发展的局势、环境或关系呢？

sentences.en: So, I guess, yeah, I can continue to offer sessions to new clients.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想，是的，我可以继续为新客户提供咨询。

sentences.en: I can continue to offer supervision, coaching sessions and one-to-one therapy.
sentences.zh: 我可以继续提供督导、教练辅导和一对一疗法。

sentences.en: Did I say that already?
sentences.zh: 我是不是已经说过了？

sentences.en: I think I did.
sentences.zh: 我想我确实说过。

sentences.en: And I can continue to help my members in the membership to be really curious, to be really courageous, to connect with myself,
sentences.zh: 我可以继续帮助会员俱乐部的成员保持强烈的好奇心、十足的勇气，并以富有同理心的方式与我、

sentences.en: with others and with the clients they're working for in a compassionate way.
sentences.zh: 与他人以及他们所服务的客户建立连接。

sentences.en: How can we reward these values when you see them in others?
sentences.zh: 当你在其他人身上看到这些价值观时，我们该如何给予奖励？

sentences.en: So, absolutely, when I see people reaching out to their network and being connected, that's something really to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 所以，绝对地，当我看到人们向他们的人脉伸出援手并建立连接时，这绝对是一件值得庆祝的事。

sentences.en: When I see they're doing things courageously, like being sad when they don't usually feel like it's safe to be sad, that takes real courage, but also compassion.
sentences.zh: 当我看到他们勇敢地做事时，比如在通常觉得不安全的时候允许自己悲伤，这需要真正的勇气，同时也需要同理心。

sentences.en: We're absolutely checking into and tapping into sadness as being a really important part of human emotion and knowing that's safe for us to do.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对是在认同并挖掘悲伤，将其视为人类情感中非常重要的一部分，并知道这样做对我们而言是安全的。

sentences.en: Okay, so the final one we're going to do in this exercise is twisting values.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们在本次练习中要做的最后一项是价值观扭曲。

sentences.en: And that's the idea that our minds can easily twist our values into rigid or unhelpful rules.
sentences.zh: 这个概念是指我们的头脑很容易将我们的价值观扭曲成僵化或无益的规则。

sentences.en: So, can we notice any of these classic twists?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们能注意到任何这些经典的扭曲吗？

sentences.en: I should do this.
sentences.zh: 我应该这样做。

sentences.en: I have to do that.
sentences.zh: 我必须这样做。

sentences.en: I must do the other.
sentences.zh: 我非得做那件事不可。

sentences.en: This is the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的事。

sentences.en: That is the wrong thing to do.
sentences.zh: 那是错误的事。

sentences.en: If I don't do this, I'm bad.
sentences.zh: 如果我不这么做，我就是坏人。

sentences.en: And if I manage to do that, I'm good.
sentences.zh: 如果我设法做到了那件事，我就是好人。

sentences.en: Remember, there are no good or bad, right or wrong, should or musts in a value.
sentences.zh: 记住，在价值观中没有好坏、对错、应该或必须。

sentences.en: And I think that's, yeah, for me, that probably comes up more with my parenting than it does with my professional life.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，是的，对我而言，这在我的育儿生活中比在我的职业生涯中出现得更多。

sentences.en: I'm also, I am compassionate.
sentences.zh: 我也很有同理心。

sentences.en: You know, I try to make sure that I am not over cramming my diary.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我努力确保我的日程表不会排得太满。

sentences.en: There's only certain slots I have in my diary each week for one to one.
sentences.zh: 我每周在一对一咨询的日程表上只有固定的几个名额。

sentences.en: And once they're full, they're full.
sentences.zh: 一旦排满，就满了。

sentences.en: And I've always worked that way since being in my first qualified role as well, which was a choice and partnership approach, a CAPA service.
sentences.zh: 而且自从我担任第一份合格职位以来，我一直都是这样工作的，那是一种选择与伙伴关系的方法，即CAPA服务。

sentences.en: And so, there was job plans.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时有工作计划。

sentences.en: So, everything was very predictable.
sentences.zh: 因此，一切都非常可预测。

sentences.en: And that really set me up well for being boundaried with my time and being compassionate to myself and being clear about what was coming and what was next.
sentences.zh: 这为我很好地界定时间边界、对自己保持同理心、明确接下来会发生什么以及下一步是什么奠定了良好的基础。

sentences.en: And so, I really, really like that way of working.
sentences.zh: 所以，我非常非常喜欢这种工作方式。

sentences.en: And that's the way that I continue to do that.
sentences.zh: 这也是我一直延续的工作方式。

sentences.en: And I might well record a podcast episode on job planning and how I use that because I absolutely still do that now.
sentences.zh: 我可能还会录制一期关于工作计划以及我是如何使用它的播客节目，因为我现在绝对还在这样做。

sentences.en: But, you know, also, sometimes the compassionate thing to do is to say no to things.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，有时富有同理心的做法其实是对某些事情说“不”。

sentences.en: So, if you get invited to things and you don't want to do them, case in point, you know, there must have been a good reason why I said yes to the musical.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你受邀参加某些活动而你又不想去的话，一个典型的例子就是，你知道的，我答应去看音乐剧一定有一个很好的理由。

sentences.en: Maybe that's still to become clear.
sentences.zh: 也许这还有待水落石出。

sentences.en: You know, also, I went to see Les Miserables with my sister-in-law recently.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，最近我还和我的小姑子一起去看了《悲惨世界》。

sentences.en: And we'd originally booked it in 20, it might have been 2018.
sentences.zh: 我们最初是在2018年订的票，可能吧。

sentences.en: And it was supposed to be taking place in 2020.
sentences.zh: 它原本定于2020年上演。

sentences.en: And, of course, it got cancelled and postponed and postponed and postponed and postponed.
sentences.zh: 当然，它被取消、推迟、推迟、再推迟、再推迟。

sentences.en: But I didn't even like the film when I watched it.
sentences.zh: 但我看电影时甚至根本不喜欢它。

sentences.en: It's just that she really, really loved the musical and really wanted to see it.
sentences.zh: 只是她非常非常喜欢这部音乐剧，并且真的很想看。

sentences.en: And nobody else fancied it with her.
sentences.zh: 而且没有别人愿意陪她去。

sentences.en: So, it was really expensive.
sentences.zh: 所以票真的很贵。

sentences.en: But because it was important to her and I didn't want her not to be able to see it, I agreed to go.
sentences.zh: 但因为这对她很重要，而我不想让她看不成，所以我同意去了。

sentences.en: And we, you know, we had a lovely time.
sentences.zh: 然后我们，你知道的，我们度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: And in the end, we went for dinner as well beforehand.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们还在演出前去吃了个晚餐。

sentences.en: We had a really nice evening.
sentences.zh: 我们度过了一个非常美好的夜晚。

sentences.en: So, I'm really pleased we did that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴我们那样做了。

sentences.en: And it was, I was pleasantly surprised.
sentences.zh: 而且，我感到惊喜连连。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢它。

sentences.en: It was a really, really great performance.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常非常精彩的演出。

sentences.en: So, sometimes we can, so long as it's not harmful to us, we can do things that we're not super thrilled with.
sentences.zh: 所以，有时只要对我们没有害处，我们可以做一些并不是超级热衷的事情。

sentences.en: And it might lead to a great outcome for us too.
sentences.zh: 而且这也可能给我们带来一个很棒的结果。

sentences.en: And, of course, that's important with connection, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，这对人际连接很重要，你知道的。

sentences.en: So, I respect my sister-in-law.
sentences.zh: 所以，我很尊重我的大嫂。

sentences.en: I love her.
sentences.zh: 我爱她。

sentences.en: If you're listening, which you're not, because you're not a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你在听的话——其实你并没有，因为你不是心理学家。

sentences.en: But maybe I'll make you listen to this one.
sentences.zh: 但也许我会让你听听这一期。

sentences.en: You know, we can be connected and we can respect others.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可以建立连接，也可以尊重他人。

sentences.en: You know, and I can be courageous into going to see things that I don't think I'm going to enjoy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可以鼓起勇气去看不觉得自己会喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: My father-in-law really loves Mamma Mia.
sentences.zh: 我岳父非常喜欢《妈妈咪呀》。

sentences.en: And so, maybe part of my reason for being courageous was to see him really enjoying himself.
sentences.zh: 所以，我表现得勇敢的一部分原因，也许是为了看他玩得那么开心。

sentences.en: So, that might well be part of my reason for saying yes to something that I wasn't actually that thrilled for.
sentences.zh: 所以，这很可能是我对其实没那么热衷的事情说“好”的部分原因。

sentences.en: Now I think about it.
sentences.zh: 现在我想想确实如此。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I guess with compassion being one of the values, there's less likely to be the shoulds and the have-tos and the rights and the wrongs.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想把同情心作为价值观之一，就会减少那些“应该”、“必须”、“正确”和“错误”。

sentences.en: And I'm bad if I don't and I'm should and I muSt.
sentences.zh: 还有“如果我不这么做我就是个坏人”，以及“我应该”和“我必须”。

sentences.en: And I, you know, if I don't, then I'm an awful human.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我不这么做，那我就是一个糟糕的人。

sentences.en: But also with that natural reflexivity and reflection that we get with curiosity, I try not to be too harsh on myself.
sentences.zh: 但同时，伴随着好奇心带来的那种自然的自我反思和审视，我尽量对别太苛刻自己。

sentences.en: And one of my friends has got about three or four full-time jobs.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友大约有三到四份全职工作。

sentences.en: And I'm always trying to encourage her to, you know, maybe to do a little less, which is ironic for a lady who does as much as I do as well.
sentences.zh: 我总是试图鼓励她，你知道的，也许少做一点，这对我这个同样做很多事的人来说还挺讽刺的。

sentences.en: But how have you found that?
sentences.zh: 但你对此有什么感受？

sentences.en: So, there is more to the exercise.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个练习还有更多内容。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I'm conscious of the time.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，我很注意时间。

sentences.en: But how have you found that?
sentences.zh: 但你对此有什么感受？

sentences.zh: 我的价值观里有没有与你的相符的，或者对你来说有什么遗漏的吗？

sentences.zh: 你为什么不把你的想法记下来呢？

sentences.zh: 我以前不怎么允许自己喝柠檬绿茶了。

sentences.en: that what I'm going to do next is, before going to get the children,
sentences.zh: 我接下来要做的是，在去接孩子们之前，

sentences.zh: 我要坐在沙发上，全心全意地享受它。

sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，有时我们可以进行短暂的自我关怀。

sentences.zh: 自我关怀并不总是敷面膜和做美甲。

sentences.zh: 与其在我的日程里硬挤出，你知道的，30、40分钟，

sentences.en: Like most people working in psychology,
sentences.zh: 我正在缓慢而坚定地朝着那个看似不可能的目标——考取临床博士学位努力。

sentences.en: I'm slowly but surely working myself up to that seemingly impossible goal of getting onto the clinical doctorate.
sentences.zh: 怀着这个最终目标，我想看看外界的情况，看看有哪些书对这方面有所帮助。

sentences.en: With that end goal in mind, I thought I'd have a look at what's out there and see what books might be helpful for this.
sentences.zh: 我偶然发现了玛丽安的书，

sentences.en: I came across Marianne's book,
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家合集》，并决定买下这本书来帮助我的旅程。

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective, and decided that this would be a great buy for me to help me on my journey.
sentences.zh: 我发现玛丽安的书信息量很大，非常有启发性。

sentences.en: I found Marianne's book really informative, most insightful.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢其中的故事，它们让我确信成为一名心理学家并不需要学术成绩完美，

sentences.en: I especially liked how the stories reassured me that you don't need to be academically perfect to become a psychologist, and that as long as you have good interpersonal skills,
sentences.zh: 只要你具备良好的社交技能，比如同情心和同理心，你就一定能成功。

sentences.en: such as compassion and empathy, you will get there.
sentences.zh: 我强烈向所有有志成为心理学家的人推荐这本书，也推荐给那些想更多了解临床心理学世界，

sentences.en: I would highly recommend this book to all aspiring psychologists, and also those who want to know a bit more about the world of clinical psychology
